# Visual & UI/UX Design System Guidelines (Taste Skill)

When designing, auditing, building, or styling web components and user interfaces, strictly follow the taste and visual design guidelines provided in `.agent/skills/taste-skill/skills/taste-skill/`.

Always refer to the following reference files for specific guidance:
- Design Critique & Standards: `.agent/skills/taste-skill/skills/taste-skill/references/critique.md`
- Layout & Grid Systems: `.agent/skills/taste-skill/skills/taste-skill/references/layout.md`
- Typography & Scale: `.agent/skills/taste-skill/skills/taste-skill/references/type.md`
- Color Harmony & Contrast: `.agent/skills/taste-skill/skills/taste-skill/references/colour.md`
- Imagery & Visuals: `.agent/skills/taste-skill/skills/taste-skill/references/imagery.md`
- Motion & Animation: `.agent/skills/taste-skill/skills/taste-skill/references/motion.md`
- Copywriting & Microcopy: `.agent/skills/taste-skill/skills/taste-skill/references/copy.md`
- Application Screens & Patterns: `.agent/skills/taste-skill/skills/taste-skill/references/app-screens.md`

Enforce tasteful design, high typography standards, clean spacing, and modern UI practices across all generated components.
